name: pin

source.prompt: One single machined steel circular mounting knob, seen straight on. Its low raised cylinder has a concentric brushed aluminum face, a central hex recess and two tiny mounting bolts. This is a solid wall peg used for hanging a lanyard. No badge, no hook below, no cord. Short cylindrical depth visible at lower right.

method: Use aligned region mask and original neutral luminance. Model used neutral top-left light. Diffuse = min(1,1.2*luma^0.74), specular shoulder above .80, preserve original alpha and unmasked pixels. Region construction is recorded in palette.ts.
